URL: https://uk.finance.yahoo.com/news/donald-trump-celebrates-reports-andy-150657850.html
(WebFetch — Yahoo Finance UK, 24 July 2026)

Trump on Burnham and North Sea oil (Truth Social): "The People of Aberdeen, in Scotland, are dancing in the streets because the new Prime Minister, Andy Burnham, has stated that he will be opening up, all the way, the invaluable North Sea Oil!"

Trump on economic impact: it would "Make the United Kingdom, from a Poverty Stricken Disaster, to one of the Richest Countries anywhere in the World."

Trump on wind energy: suggested moving "the old and horrible looking windmills, which loom over and destroy the City of Aberdeen."

Uplift response (Robert Palmer, deputy director): "It's now an ultra-mature basin that has been in decline for years. Of course Donald Trump wants us to remain dependent on fossil fuels – and on US gas specifically – but that's not in the UK's national interest."

Burnham's official position: has "not confirmed reports" about approving new drilling and "has promised to honour" Labour's 2024 manifesto commitment against issuing new North Sea licences, though he is reportedly "open-minded" about existing project approvals.
